title: Move the mouse to the right window
summary: During the session, the user instructed Addy to move the mouse to the right window, which led the assistant to switch applications and inadvertently attempt a browser scroll. When the user questioned what had just happened, Addy apologized and explained that the unintended window switch occurred while trying to scroll. The assistant successfully clarified that all current applications remained open on the screen despite the navigation error. However, the session was left unfinished as Addy asked the user to remind them what they were originally looking at before getting sidetracked, which should be picked up next time to resume the task.
